decision.reasoning_trace: The consideration set was chosen based on the overall rating and review count of the products. The final choice, Alkem Mechanical Gaming Keyboard, was selected due to its high rating of 4.4 and a reasonable price of $39.11. The other products in the consideration set, such as VELOCIFIRE Tenkeyless Mechanical Keyboard and Code V3 104-Key Illuminated Mechanical Keyboard, were also highly rated but had lower review counts or higher prices.
